cards.title: Say thirsty

Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.
cards.name: Everyday English - A1 - Day 148 - Pronunciation & Listening - 01

articulation.label: thirsty
articulation.alt: thirsty: /θ/ → /ɝ/ → /s/ → /t/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /θ/: Tongue tip lightly at or between the teeth.
/ɝ/: Bunch the tongue for American r; no tip contact.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
